shipped_outputs.results/*.json: Produced by the revision with Python 3.12.14 (circle and ellipse scripts) and the same NumPy/SciPy/Matplotlib versions; results/ellipse_environment.json records the environment of the ellipse experiment.

pdf_engine: pdfTeX (TeX Live 2026, TinyTeX), two passes of pdflatex manuscript.tex
reproducibility: Outputs reproduce to floating-point roundoff, not bit for bit across Python and BLAS builds. In the release replay (normal and -O) the symbolic sphere, sphere/torus and torus-of-revolution outputs were byte-identical; every other number agreed to a relative 1.4e-8 or better, apart from quantities that are themselves at roundoff level (scaling residuals and grid discrepancies below 1e-10, which differ at roundoff). The figures are regenerated with negligible pixel differences.
